title: Pocketwire Personal Account Unauthorized-Payment Claim Timetable and Liability Caps
content:
The time limits and liability caps that govern unauthorized-payment claims on a Pocketwire Personal Account are set per plan.

| Figure | Lite | Core | Plus | Prime | Onyx | Summit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Report window (calendar days after the disputed payment's transaction date) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 90 | 120 |
| Timely notice (business days after the transaction date) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Liability cap with timely notice (USD) | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Liability cap with later notice inside the report window (USD) | 500.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Provisional credit timing (business days after the claim report date) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 5 | 5 | 3 |
| Provisional credit timing for a new-account payment (business days) | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| Investigation deadline (business days after the claim report date) | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 30 | 30 |
| Investigation deadline for a new-account payment (calendar days after the claim report date) | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| New-account period (calendar days after the account opened date) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |

The plan names are shortened in the header: Lite is Pocketwire Lite, Core is Pocketwire Core, Plus is Pocketwire Plus, Prime is Pocketwire Prime, Onyx is Pocketwire Onyx and Summit is Pocketwire Summit.

### Meaning of the rows

- **Report window** — the calendar days after the disputed payment's transaction date within which an unauthorized-payment claim is accepted.
- **Timely notice** — the business days after the transaction date within which a report counts as timely notice for the liability cap.
- **Liability caps** — the maximum customer liability on an approved claim reported with timely notice, and on one reported after timely notice but inside the report window.
- **Provisional credit timing** — the business days after the claim report date at which provisional credit is posted if the claim is still unresolved; the new-account figure replaces it when the disputed payment occurred within the new-account period.
- **Investigation deadlines** — the business days (or, for a new-account payment, calendar days) after the claim report date by which the investigation must be resolved.
- **New-account period** — the calendar days after the account opened date during which a disputed payment counts as a new-account transaction.

On Pocketwire Onyx and Pocketwire Summit both liability caps are 0.00; on Pocketwire Prime only the timely-notice cap is.
